name: Fishy Fred
bio: Walked out of the river in his best red sneakers. Nobody has told him about the smell.
notes: Import list batch 1 (docs/IMPORT_LIST.md; "Fishy Fred", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains for the thumb, middle and little finger only, no index or ring finger, so the fingers are re-fitted by hands.mjs; its two clips are not used). A big-headed fish on striped legs in red sneakers, a fin down its back and its tail curled up behind its head. Name a placeholder (the download's own) until the owner names it. A 5k-triangle download, kept whole. Small for its short body.
